title: LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches
abstract: Reinforcement learning has greatly advanced the capabilities of large language models, but its memory demands remain a barrier to broader adoption. We introduce LoGRA, an approach to RL post-training that reduces memory by retaining useful learning signals in low-rank gradient sketches. These compact representations support both model updates and efficient policy synchronization. To prevent overly large updates from disrupting learning, we complement gradient compression with predicted-KL step control, which estimates policy changes before applying each update and adjusts its magnitude accordingly. With all techniques combined, LoGRA reduces average training memory usage by up to 45.7% across reasoning tasks without compromising performance. It also enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where dense Adam runs out of memory, making previously memory-infeasible RL training practical. Code is available in the \href{this https URL}{Molt library}.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In our hypothetical graduate course, Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Language Models, today's lecture is on “LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches.” Recent work such as GaLore and “QeRL: Beyond Efficiency -- Quantization-enhanced Reinforcement Learning for LLMs” reflects a field-wide push to make post-training more affordable. This paper, from authors associated with NVIDIA, focuses instead on compressing the learning signal itself. That matters because reinforcement learning needs memory for generation as well as training. I see your hand, Noah; go ahead.
segments.zh: 在我们假设的研究生课程“语言模型的高效强化学习”中，今天的讲座是“LoGRA：用低秩梯度草图扩展LLM强化学习”。最近的工作，比如GaLore和“QeRL：超越效率——量化增强的LLM强化学习”，反映了整个领域都在推动让后训练变得更便宜。这篇论文的作者来自NVIDIA，它转而关注压缩学习信号本身。这很重要，因为强化学习既需要生成时的内存，也需要训练时的内存。我看到你举手了，Noah，请讲。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, why focus on gradients if systems already use sharding and offloading?
segments.zh: 教授您好，既然系统已经用了分片和卸载，为什么还要关注梯度呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Good question. Sharding and offloading help distribute or relocate model states, but they do not make those states disappear. Reinforcement learning repeatedly generates responses, evaluates them, and updates the policy, so optimizer states, gradients, activations, and synchronization buffers all compete for memory. LoGRA asks whether the gradient representation can be made smaller while still updating the original full-sized weights. It is a complementary approach, not a replacement for system techniques.
segments.zh: 这个问题问得好。分片和卸载确实能帮助分散或迁移模型状态，但它们并不能让这些状态消失。强化学习会反复生成回复、评估结果并更新策略，所以优化器状态、梯度、激活值和同步缓冲区都在争抢内存。LoGRA 要问的是，能不能在仍然更新原始全尺寸权重的前提下，把梯度的表示变得更小。它是一种互补的思路，而不是要取代系统层面的技术。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The central idea is to project each selected weight matrix’s gradient into a much narrower random subspace. Instead of retaining a full gradient, the method stores a compact sketch and accumulates that sketch directly across microbatches. The projection is random rather than learned, and its rank controls the sketch’s width. After an optimizer transformation, the sketch is mapped back into a weight update, so the model remains full-sized even though each individual update is low-rank.
segments.zh: 核心思路是把每个被选中的权重矩阵的梯度投影到一个窄得多的随机子空间里。它不保留完整梯度，而是存一个紧凑的sketch，并且直接在各个microbatch之间累积这个sketch。这个投影是随机的，不是学出来的，它的秩决定了sketch的宽度。经过优化器变换之后，sketch会被映射回一个权重更新，所以模型本身仍然是全尺寸的，尽管每一次单独的更新是低秩的。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: does the low-rank update mean the model can only learn low-rank patterns permanently?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：低秩更新是不是意味着模型永远只能学到低秩的模式？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. Each update is constrained to a low-rank direction, but LoGRA refreshes its random projection at every training step. Over time, those changing subspaces can expose the model to different update directions. Think of taking narrow snapshots from different angles rather than permanently locking the model into one narrow view. The method applies sketches to attention and MLP projection matrices in the main experiments, while holding other parameters fixed.
segments.zh: 不是。每次更新都被限制在一个低秩方向上，但LoGRA在每个训练步都会刷新它的随机投影。随着时间推移，这些不断变化的子空间能让模型接触到不同的更新方向。可以把它想象成从不同角度拍摄狭窄的快照，而不是把模型永久锁死在一个狭窄的视角里。在主实验中，该方法对注意力和MLP投影矩阵应用草图，同时保持其他参数不变。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A second contribution addresses policy stability. Even a memory-efficient update could shift next-token probabilities too sharply. LoGRA estimates the likely change in those probabilities on a sample of current training contexts, then scales the update to fit a chosen K-L budget. The estimate is local, and the realized change can differ, but the controller gives the method a way to limit update magnitude without changing the update direction.
segments.zh: 第二个贡献是解决策略稳定性问题。就算更新再省内存，也可能让下一个token的概率分布变化太剧烈。LoGRA会在当前训练上下文的一个样本上，估计这些概率可能发生的变化，然后按选定的K-L预算来缩放更新幅度。这个估计是局部的，实际变化可能不一样，但有了这个控制器，方法就能在不改变更新方向的前提下限制更新的幅度。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify how the sketch saves memory during backpropagation, rather than just after it?
segments.zh: 你能说明一下这个草图是怎么在反向传播过程中节省内存的，而不只是在反向传播之后才节省吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That distinction is important. A conventional compression step would first create the full gradient and only then shrink it, leaving the large temporary buffer in place. LoGRA instead projects the inputs used in the weight-gradient calculation before combining them with the backward derivatives. The compact representation is accumulated directly across microbatches. Its main experiments use RowAdam, which tracks a second-moment statistic per sketch row but omits first-moment momentum.
segments.zh: 这个区别很重要。传统的压缩步骤会先算出完整梯度，然后再把它缩小，那个大的临时缓冲区始终都在。LoGRA则不同，它会在把输入与反向导数结合之前，先对用于计算权重梯度的输入做投影。压缩后的表示直接跨微批次累积。它的主要实验用的是RowAdam，这种方法按草图行跟踪二阶矩统计量，但省略了一阶动量。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: There is also a systems benefit at synchronization time. The rollout engine can receive the compact update factor and the seed needed to recreate its random projection, rather than a dense update matrix. In tests on one node with 8 H-one-hundred G-P-Us, the method reduced average training memory by 21.8% at 1.5 billion parameters and 45.7% at 7 billion. Throughput was similar to dense Adam at those sizes.
segments.zh: 同步时还有一个系统层面的好处。轨迹引擎收到的是紧凑的更新因子和重建随机投影所需的种子，而不是一个稠密的更新矩阵。在单节点8块H100 GPU上的测试中，该方法在15亿参数规模下将平均训练内存降低了21.8%，在70亿参数规模下降低了45.7%。在这些规模下，吞吐量与稠密Adam相当。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How strong is the performance evidence, especially for the largest model?
segments.zh: 性能证据到底有多强，尤其是最大那个模型？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: At 7 billion parameters, LoGRA and dense Adam reached similar peak math-reasoning scores: 72.33% versus 72.48% Pass at 1, and 85.13% versus 85.33% Pass at 4. At 1.5 billion, LoGRA scored higher than the dense baseline on those reported measures. At 27 billion, dense Adam ran out of memory, while LoGRA trained at a reported peak of 53.88 gibibytes per G-P-U. That shows feasibility on the tested setup, but there is no dense accuracy comparison at that size.
segments.zh: 在70亿参数规模下，LoGRA和稠密Adam达到了相近的数学推理峰值分数：Pass@1分别为72.33%和72.48%，Pass@4分别为85.13%和85.33%。在15亿参数规模下，LoGRA在所报告的这些指标上得分高于稠密基线。在270亿参数规模下，稠密Adam出现了内存不足，而LoGRA的训练峰值报告为每块GPU 53.88吉比字节。这表明在测试配置下是可行的，但该规模下没有与稠密方法的准确率对比。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The longer 27-billion-parameter run offers useful but limited evidence about sustained learning. On a mixture of eight reasoning tasks, the held-out verifier score rose from 39.69% initially to a peak of 65.52% around step 1,060. Response lengths and truncation rates also declined. This is one training trajectory, not a multi-seed result. In ablations, higher projection rank improved gradient reconstruction and generally improved Pass at 1, while refreshing and projection distribution showed no consistent advantage.
segments.zh: 更长的270亿参数训练提供了有用但有限的持续学习证据。在八个推理任务的混合上，留出验证器分数从最初的39.69%上升到第1060步左右的峰值65.52%。回复长度和截断率也下降了。这只是一条训练轨迹，不是多种子结果。在消融实验中，更高的投影秩改善了梯度重建，并且总体上提升了Pass@1，而刷新和投影分布没有表现出持续的优势。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So how does this relate to lora, and what should we be cautious about?
segments.zh: 那么这和LoRA有什么关系，我们又该注意些什么呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: LoRA trains small adapters while freezing most original weights; LoGRA instead uses compact gradient sketches to update selected full-weight matrices. In the 1.5-billion-parameter comparison, LoGRA used less memory, but LoRA had a higher mean Pass at 1, and the setup differed in optimizers and schedules. The K-L tests also suggest calibration matters: a larger constant budget performed worse than smaller or annealed budgets. These results support careful follow-up, not a universal guarantee of stability.
segments.zh: LoRA 训练的是小型适配器，同时冻结大部分原始权重；而 LoGRA 则用紧凑的梯度草图来更新选定的全权重矩阵。在 15 亿参数规模的对比中，LoGRA 占用的内存更少，但 LoRA 在 Pass@1 上的平均值更高，而且两者的优化器和调度方案并不相同。K-L 测试还表明，校准很关键：较大的固定预算反而比更小或退火式的预算表现更差。这些结果支持的是谨慎的后续跟进，而不是对稳定性的普遍保证。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The broader implication is that gradient representation can be another practical lever for expanding the hardware configurations available for reinforcement learning. This connects naturally to GaLore’s gradient-projection approach, while LoGRA adapts compact gradient accumulation to the generation-and-training cycle and adds policy-change control. The evidence is concentrated on Qwen reasoning models and selected matrices, so broader tasks, model families, objectives, and hardware remain important tests. The takeaway is simple: smaller updates can make full-weight reinforcement learning more feasible, provided their information and magnitude are managed carefully. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 更广泛的意义在于，梯度的表示方式可以成为另一个实用杠杆，用来拓展强化学习可用的硬件配置。这与 GaLore 的梯度投影思路自然衔接，而 LoGRA 则把紧凑的梯度累积适配到生成与训练的循环中，并加入了策略变化控制。现有证据主要集中在 Qwen 推理模型和部分选定矩阵上，因此更广泛的任务、模型家族、目标函数和硬件仍然是重要的测试方向。结论很简单：更小的更新可以让全权重强化学习更可行，前提是它们的信息量和幅度得到谨慎管理。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
